summary: Fuel sufficiency check for AI pit strategy. Returns TRUE immediately when the FuelMult global (dword_7D0B64) is zero (check disabled). Otherwise compares the remaining-laps quantity (TotalRaceLaps minus lap number, reduced by a stint factor) against a fuel-consumption estimate (fuel rate factor times theoretical laps per litre minus a margin) and returns TRUE when the remaining-laps quantity is the smaller one.
